title: Publish price feed
description: Publish a price feed for a smartcoin you are authorized to feed.
selectAssetInfo: Choose a smartcoin (1.3.x). Prefill via ?id=1.3.x from the Issued Assets page.
currentFeedInfo: Reference settlement price from the blockchain's current feed.
settlementBaseInfo: Smartcoin amount (base leg) in human units.
settlementQuoteInfo: Collateral amount (quote leg) in human units, e.g. BTS.
cerBaseInfo: Core exchange rate smartcoin leg in human units.
cerQuoteInfo: Core exchange rate collateral leg in human units.
mcrInfo: E.g. 175 means 175%. Stored on-chain as percent * 10.
mssrInfo: E.g. 110 means 110%. Stored on-chain as percent * 10.
publisherInfo: The account publishing this feed. Must be an authorized feed producer.
invalidAsset: Provide a valid smartcoin via ?id=1.3.x, e.g. from Issued Assets.
notSmartcoin: This asset is not a smartcoin and cannot receive price feeds.
notAuthorized: Your account is not the issuer nor a known feed publisher for this asset. The chain may reject the operation.
isAuthorized: Your account appears authorized to publish for this asset.
priceDeviation: Your price deviates {{pct}}% from the current feed. Double-check before publishing.
missingAmounts: Enter positive settlement and CER amounts plus valid MCR/MSSR.
noPriorFeed: No prior feed from your account found for this asset.
settlementBlockedInfo: This smartcoin has been globally settled. Its collateral sits in the settlement fund and new price feeds have no effect until the settlement is resolved.
individualSettlementActiveInfo: {{debt}} {{asset}} of undercollateralized debt was settled into {{fund}} {{collateral}}. The asset otherwise operates normally, so you may still publish feeds.
